coaching.headline: Fights decided the game: allies won eight of twelve, and late wins turned into four enemy towers, two Fangtooths and Genesis Core.

flags.text: Drongo's 42522 hero damage led all ten players, a damn clinic: 1772 a minute on an 880 norm.
By minute ten: Kira and Adele fell to Drongo four times, Narbash once; Drongo died once.
Gideon's seven kills were the shit part: six landed on Howitzer and Khaimera, the rest on Narbash.

focus.title: Convert fights, deny Gideon
focus.action: After each won fight, hit the nearest tower or objective; Howitzer and Khaimera add magical armor and engage Gideon only after Torn Space is used.

16.9.call: Won 4-1 with kills from Drongo, Khaimera and Howitzer, and allied Fangtooth followed. Textbook order: fight first, pit second.

20.6.call: Won 4-0, Drongo killing Adele, Kira and Aurora and Howitzer killing Gideon; Howitzer then razed the enemy mid outer and Drongo the duo inner. Clean conversion; repeat the pattern.

23.5.call: Two separate plays after Steel took the allied offlane outer: Greystone killed Aurora, Howitzer killed Steel on the offlane, Drongo killed Adele. With a lead this size, answer a lost tower with an enemy tower.

600f7046-be2c-4d1a-b6bf-5e2fa25d7b31: Razed the enemy duo outer and duo inner on top of 17 kills. With Kira dead, keep taking the next duo tower.
Killed Adele on mid 13 seconds after Howitzer died there, and Gideon 9 seconds after Khaimera fell, before allied Fangtooth. Answer every ally death that fast.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Healed 33875, the most in the game, with 68% kill participation. Once Steel's Shield Slam is spent, open with Thunk, then peel for Drongo.
Placed 10 wards to Adele's 14 and cleared zero. With Leafsong raising the ward cap to three, keep three wards down around Fangtooth before every spawn.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zero deaths and 29520 damage mitigated, the most among allies. With no tank in the draft, take the first hits when Steel or Aurora starts fights.
11.2 CS a minute against an 8.8 norm, 45 minions from the enemy jungle, and the enemy offlane outer razed. When Steel shows elsewhere, keep invading those camps.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Gideon scored three of five deaths. When Black Hole drops, walk out at once, since the pull drags slowly.
Topped all ten players with 8611 objective damage and took Genesis Core and the last Fangtooth. With Aurora dead or shown elsewhere, keep taking those neutrals.
Two wards against a 4.7 norm and one enemy ward cleared. If wards were equipped, place two before Fangtooth; with a sentry, sweep the pit first.
8d476153-0fea-45bd-b912-63f31734044b: Three deaths to Gideon outside any detected fight. When Gideon has abilities up, sidestep the Void Breach comet and the Cosmic Rift meteor before trading.
Second-most hero damage in the game at 27691, with first blood among four kills on Gideon. Whenever Gideon falls, push the mid tower before taking camps.

matchup: Carry matchup into Kira: field record 49.9% over 385 games, a coin-flip lane on paper.
Kira finished 4/8/3 with 15498 hero damage; Kira and Aurora each scored two of the five deaths.
build: Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds is the best core into Kira, with all three items built.
Imperator makes critical strikes deal more damage; Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
Tainted Rounds came last, so the healing cut sat out all but the final fight.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health damage on every third consecutive basic attack on the same hero; Serration adds missing-health damage.
Vermis ranks last among ranked Eternals in this hero-role field; Xyris and Thraex lead a toss-up.
Serration with Sub-Surface has too few games to rank; Serration with Melting Point is the best-ranked Vermis pair.
augment: Bring The Boom makes exploding Rad Rounds deal part of the damage to nearby enemies.
Shred Spree leans over Bring The Boom in this field: Shrapnel Cannon far more often, at half damage.
crest: Pacifier dashes and empowers the next physical hit, far stronger on low-health targets, with a recast after a quick hero kill.
Pacifier leads a toss-up with Liberator in this field; a sound keep.
improvement: No item change proven: no unmet need, and the best core into Kira was complete.
Xyris over Vermis is the field-backed Eternal swap: damage that grows with units killed, giving up the max-health hits.

matchup: Duo against Kira and Adele: 7504 of Adele's 10501 hero damage was true damage, unaffected by armor.
Hero damage taken split 7915 physical, 5086 magical and 5114 true, so no single armor type covered the bulk.
build: Truesilver Bracelet, Crystal Tear and Dynamo is the field's winning core at 57.8%, fully built.
Dynamo makes an immobilized enemy take more damage briefly; the stun from Thunk is a trigger.
Truesilver Bracelet shields the caster on each ultimate cast, with CC immunity while the shield holds.
eternal: Exarch gives healed or shielded targets attack speed and bonus magical damage on basic attacks.
Exarch leans first in this hero-role field; no swap needed.
Illumination with Fervour is not a top pair; Preservation with Delayed Fate ranks best under Exarch.
augment: Thonk drops Thunk to the floor after an enemy hit; picking the drumstick up refunds part of the cooldown and mana.
Thonk leads a toss-up with War Anthem in this field; a sound keep.
crest: The Leafsong active speeds nearby allies, makes allies immune to slows and lets allies pass through heroes.
Sanctification leans first in this hero-role field; Leafsong ranks third of the well-played crests, behind Sanctification and Tranquility.
improvement: Everbloom next completes the best field core, 65% over 206 games, adding mitigation and tenacity for healed allies.
Sanctification over Leafsong is the field lean: a group shield with tenacity instead of the speed burst, same three-ward cap.

matchup: Offlane into Steel: field lane record 51.2% over 350 games.
Steel dealt 13962 magical hero damage, and 15307 of the 19135 hero damage taken here was magical.
build: Tainted Bastion fit the hit: magical armor, and taking magical damage briefly cuts the attacker's healing.
Forticus met the tenacity need against the extra enemy hard CC; a keep.
Overlord, Rapture and Aegis Of Agawar is the field's winning core at 55.3%; only Overlord was built.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health that grows with level, plus bonus size; Cannibalism adds permanent health on takedowns.
Krix sits in a toss-up with Nihil atop this field; Voracity with Cannibalism ranks best under Krix.
augment: Tainted Oath puts Blight on Sacred Oath hits, and Tainted Bastion's damage mitigation doubles against Blighted targets.
Tainted Oath is in a three-way toss-up led by Imperial Soul; a sound keep.
crest: Saphir's Mantle grows size and max health briefly, damages nearby heroes, then adds permanent max health from that damage.
Saphir's Mantle is a toss-up contender behind Eviscerator in this field; no swap needed.
improvement: Into Steel the field buys Sky Splitter at 29% versus a usual 21%, winning 52.9%; worth testing as a later slot.
Basilisk also rises into Steel, 30% versus 17%, but wins only 50.8%.

matchup: Jungle into Aurora: field record 51.7% over 444 games; Aurora finished 4/7/5 and fell twice to this jungler.
Magical damage made up 10578 of the 15226 hero damage taken.
build: Only Overlord and Draconum finished; Basilisk and Rapture from the field's winning core were never built.
Draconum restores health on takedowns and adds physical armor, but no magical armor against this enemy damage.
eternal: Knell shreds physical and magical armor with Rust stacks and returns part of the shredded armor.
Frequency with Peal is the best-ranked Knell minor pair.
Knell has too few games here to lead; Lotus leans first in this hero-role field.
augment: Jungle Invasion adds physical power in jungles, doubled in the enemy jungle, where 62 minions fell.
Jungle Invasion leans first in this field; a sound keep.
crest: Judgement deals area damage around the user and heals on hero hits, weaker on later hits.
Pacifier leans first in this hero-role field; Judgement ranks fifth.
improvement: Void Helm answers the magical-armor need against Gideon, and the field buys Void Helm twice as often into Aurora, winning 52.7%.
Salvation adds the missing tenacity against a ten-to-six hard-CC gap, at the cost of a later item slot.

matchup: Mid into Gideon: field lane record 53.1% over 221 games.
Magical damage made up 17263 of the 20474 hero damage taken, with no magical armor built.
build: An on-hit build: Prophecy, Spectra and Sky Splitter all trigger on basic attacks; no field-core item was built.
Nuclear Rounds, finished last, raises ability damage with critical chance and missed the earlier fights.
The most-played core into Gideon is Combustion, Wraith Leggings and Noxia, at 50% over 66 games.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage against that hero, less damage taken from that hero.
Thraex has too few games here to lead; Vesh leads a toss-up with Aion.
The King with Ferocity is a rare pair; Savage Strikes with Ferocity ranks best under Thraex.
augment: Combat Thrusters adds movement speed during Make It Rain.
Combat Thrusters is the clear Best pick in this hero-role field; keep.
crest: Typhoon stacks attack speed on basic attacks and dashes at four stacks, fitting the on-hit build.
Soulbearer and Epoch lead a toss-up in this field; Typhoon ranks behind the pair.
improvement: Magical armor first: Gideon killed this mid three times, and penetration added an estimated 16% to Gideon's magical damage here.
World Breaker adds tenacity and magical power together, at the cost of an on-hit slot.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
ourKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
ourKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
ourKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
ourKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
ourKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
ourKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: H11 Cluster Grenades and Land Mine to slow and stun, R2000 Missile charged for full damage, then Make It Rain on the held enemies.
ourKits.winCondition: Lock down space with grenades and mines and rain missiles on enemies stuck in them.
ourKits.passive: Armed Salvo empowers his next basic with area damage that restores mana, and each ability cast shortens its cooldown.
ourKits.playWith: CC and chokepoints that force enemies into his zones.
ourKits.playAgainst: Walk around grenades and get out of Land Mine's blast before it goes off. He can blast himself away with Land Mine, so engage after it is used; magical armor helps against his burst.

enemyKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
enemyKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
enemyKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
enemyKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
enemyKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
enemyKits.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

enemyKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
enemyKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
enemyKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
enemyKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Narbash can stay with the carry and peel.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,130 hero damage a minute, more than 77% of Gideon mid players this patch (32% of the team's). The damage came from Combustion, Wraith Leggings.
Black Hole at top rank: 105s base, about 95.5s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Azure Core 10.
Gideon dealt 27,119 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +255 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11; against Howitzer (level 13 estimated: about 42 magical armor, 22 after penetration) and Khaimera (level 13 estimated: about 51 magical armor, 31 after penetration) that is about 16% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Sustain: Azure Core: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 100 (+12%) Shield for 5s.; 1,138 healing recorded.

Lesson: Gideon's penetration cut through: Howitzer took about 16% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 13 (estimated) their armor was about 42, about 22 after 20 flat penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 10 ability haste brought them back 9% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Countered? 0 of the 3 players Gideon killed built magical armor. We killed Gideon 6 times.
Copy it? Too few Gideon midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

THEORY at lane edges.

evidence: 17/5/1, 42522 hero damage, the most in the game.
Hero damage per minute 1772 vs their Drongo norm 880.

bullets: Combustion's area burst fired on an ability hit, then went on cooldown, which hitting heroes shortened; Wraith Leggings added 12% ability damage against heroes below 40% health.
Vesh added lingering damage to ability hits on heroes, Lich healed Gideon for part of the magical damage, and Phylactery shielded Gideon and sped cooldowns after Black Hole.
Torn Space and enemy heroes caught in Black Hole briefly raised max mana, speeding Void Breach's cooldown; Torn Space right before Black Hole grew Phylactery's shield.
Each basic attack carried Tainted Rounds' on-hit damage, which grows as the target's health drops, and cut the target's healing by 45%, finishing low-health enemies faster.
Three quick basic attacks on one hero set off Vermis for a share of that hero's max health, plus Serration's missing-health damage; Sub-Surface cut damage from area abilities.
Imperator made critical strikes deal 30% more and each one applied Wastelander's bleed; Lightning Hawk added an empowered, slowing shot whenever Momentum reached 100 stacks.
Truesilver Bracelet shielded Narbash on casting Crash Bang Boom!, and while the shield held, crowd control could not break the drum solo.
Fervour healed Narbash and nearby allies on basic attacks against enemy heroes; each heal gave the healed hero Exarch's attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage.
Fervour heals on allies set off Crystal Tear, briefly giving both heroes 30 Magical Power and 15 ability haste; Illumination added health regeneration equal to bonus mana regeneration.
